name: Cookie Banner
description: Consent banner with equal Accept all and Reject all buttons and a Choose panel for analytics and marketing, as UK and EU rules expect.
usage: Render <CookieBanner /> once in the root layout, only if the site uses non-essential cookies (analytics that set cookies, ads, some embeds). Save the choice from onChoice in a first-party cookie or browser storage, pass open={false} once a choice exists, load analytics or ad scripts only when allowed, and add a footer link that clears the saved choice so people can change their mind.
